prompts.label: Watery diarrhea

visual.shape: formless liquid splatter, puddle with irregular edges, may have some small chunks
visual.color: brown liquid, may be lighter brown due to water content
visual.distinguishingFeature: completely liquid, no solid form, spreads out like spilled liquid
visual.surface: wet puddle appearance, uneven edges, may have bubbles or separate liquid pools
visual.realLifeNote: Like brown water or thin gravy spilled on the ground - no solid form at all

prompts.prompt: Create a clean semi-realistic illustration, medical education style, simplified but accurate shapes of dog stool for a veterinary education app. Use realistic natural earth tones, true-to-life colors. Background: plain solid light neutral gray (#F0F0F0) background, no textures or patterns. Rendering: soft shading with realistic form, gentle shadow underneath for grounding. Camera angle: slightly elevated 3/4 view, as if looking down at the ground. SHAPE: formless liquid splatter, puddle with irregular edges, may have some small chunks. COLOR: brown liquid, may be lighter brown due to water content. KEY IDENTIFYING FEATURE: completely liquid, no solid form, spreads out like spilled liquid. SURFACE/TEXTURE: wet puddle appearance, uneven edges, may have bubbles or separate liquid pools. REAL LIFE REFERENCE: Like brown water or thin gravy spilled on the ground - no solid form at all. Do NOT include: text or labels, cartoon faces or expressions, flies or insects, smell lines or stink marks, grass or outdoor environment, overly gross or disgusting details. This must look realistic enough that a pet owner can compare it to their dog's actual stool. The image should clearly show the distinguishing characteristics so owners know what to look for.

prompts.label: Pale, gray, or clay-colored

visual.shape: log shape similar to normal stool
visual.color: pale grayish-tan or clay-colored with slight yellow tint, noticeably lighter than healthy brown
visual.distinguishingFeature: abnormally pale color - gray, tan, or clay-like instead of normal brown
visual.surface: may appear slightly greasy or fatty looking
visual.realLifeNote: Like wet clay or putty color - grayish-tan, clearly not the normal brown color
